verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents role-based access scoped down to the table and column level, alongside SSO through the customer's identity provider. That covers the roles, tables and columns parts of the story, but nothing in the evidence addresses row-level policies or masking. Support comes from a single marketing-page line rather than detailed docs. Missing for 10: row-level security/row policies, column masking policies, in-depth first-party documentation of the access-control model, independent or hands-on corroboration.
